example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading, the Prepaid Expenses account, September 2026. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

messages.text: Can you check our prepaid account for September and set up a proper schedule?
Yes. Before I read anything, I need eight answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload the data?
Which account or accounts hold your prepaids?
What are the cover start and end dates of each open item? Please also send your current schedule, if you have one.
What is your materiality threshold? Below it, a payment goes straight to expense. I never set it for you.
Do you spread each cost by whole months or by days?
Do you recover sales tax such as VAT when you pay, and in which country?
Which currency do you use, and what is your policy for prepaids in a foreign currency?

messages.text: Use MosoFin. Northbrook Trading, account Prepaid Expenses. The dates for five items are in the attached file. Nobody has the dates for the expo booth. We have no schedule. Our limit is $1,000. Whole months. We are in the US, with no VAT. US dollars only.

messages.label: Checked the workspace and the company file
messages.summary: The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

messages.text: Here is my plan. I build the **September** prepaid schedule for **Northbrook Trading**, account **Prepaid Expenses**. Materiality is **$1,000**, with whole-month amortization and no recoverable tax. You gave cover dates for **5 of 6** items. The expo booth goes on the schedule with blank dates and the flag "unknown". I do not guess dates.
messages.after: I read the account back to its oldest open item, for at least 24 months. Shall I start?

messages.label: Read the books in one batch
rows: Bills and payments behind each item
messages.summary: One batch of reads. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: Before I use your dates, the account itself shows three problems:

card.title: What the ledger shows
head: Finding
Amount
What it means
rows: Pixelform Studio, a year of software, all expensed in April
Round sum to Riverside Properties, the landlord

messages.after: Your file shows that Pixelform covers 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027. Does the lease say that the landlord pays the $5,000 back?

messages.text: Yes, we get it back when the lease ends.
Then it is a deposit, not a prepaid. Here is the schedule from your dates. Each cost starts on its cover start, not on the payment date:
messages.after: Cobalt was paid on 15 June, but its cover starts on 1 July. A June start puts $400 too much in expense by 30 September. A membership of $600 and hosting of $480 are each below $1,000. They go to expense, and the coverage sheet shows their total of **$1,080**.

messages.text: Your account and its own roll-forward both say **$22,100**. That proves only that the books add up. The schedule is the real test:
messages.after: The account is **$7,250** too high, and each part of that has a name.

messages.text: I propose three entries and one move. Each one points to its evidence:

card.title: Proposed, not posted
head: Entry
Amount
Evidence
rows: E2 August catch-up: insurance 550, software 400, maintenance 150
No August entry in the ledger
E3 Pixelform: move October to March back to the asset, 6 × 250
Move the Riverside payment to Deposits

messages.after: E2 also clears the $550 left on last year's policy. You choose its posting date. After all four, the account and the schedule both show **$16,350**.

messages.text: On the balance sheet, the $16,350 splits by time:

card.title: Prepaid Expenses after the entries
rows: + Expo booth, not split until you give its dates

messages.after: Your chart has no non-current prepaid account, so the $450 shows as current. Please also set up the monthly entry in QuickBooks again. Next month, I check that it ran.

messages.text: Can we deduct the whole insurance premium on this year's tax return?
I calculate the cost for your books only. US tax has a 12-month rule that can sometimes allow it. Please ask your accountant. Your books still show $600 a month.
messages.after: A person posts these entries. I do not. Do you want the seven sheets as an Excel file? And shall I save your settings for next month?

messages.text: Done. The Excel file has the seven sheets. I saved the account, whole-month, your $1,000 threshold, the cover dates, the renewal months and the errors found. The expo booth stays flagged until you give its dates.
